headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Darby Allin vs. Mike Bennett fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.08 ? a good, competitive contest. Mike Bennett was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 60th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In his first defense of his second TNT Title reign, Allin outlasted a hard-hitting challenge from former WWE star Mike Bennett to retain the championship.

Looking back to 2021, when Kenny Omega vs. Rey Fenix went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.88 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. Rey Fenix was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Back on this day in 2024, Eddie Kingston vs. Trent Beretta went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.39 ? a solid showing. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: On a Friday in 2023, back when Charlette Renegade laced up for their first AEW match against Britt Baker vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Robyn Renegade, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.06.

Looking back to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Kip Sabian went to battle over the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.79. For Kip Sabian, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
2024 brought us this moment: The Kingdom was no more, reborn as The Undisputed Kingdom after 6 matches, on Collision.
